deadline.originalText: October 28, 2026, 2:00 p.m. Midland local time (CDT), City-issued RFP schedule

sourceCheck.detail: City-issued 23-page RFP 27000010 text §§1.19,4.5,5.5,7 and schedule inspected on GovTribe mirror at https://govtribe.com/file/government-file/001-rfp-27000010-lidar-geospatial-data-acquisition-dot-pdf; City Bonfire portal original listing confirmed by published source catalog; obtain authoritative PDF bytes and any addenda before quoting or submitting. Original body City of Midland, despite GovTribe metadata incorrectly labeling Mason County.

requirements.description: Prime minimum five years government/municipal LiDAR relevant experience
USGS Quality Level 1 LiDAR delivery experience, sensors and staff
Impervious polygon extraction and municipal parcel-level stormwater mapping
Core LiDAR and impervious acquisition/processing in-house absent City prior written approval
Three comparable government reference projects completed within five years with contactable buyer personnel
Texas-required workers compensation and other original RFP insurance limits
Any proposed independent QA subcontract expressly disclosed with City approval
Esri strict four feature-class schemas and City data-dictionary/sample acceptance
Capacity for 390-square-mile leaf-off LiDAR and 67,455 parcel mapping by required schedule

partners.name: Woolpert (candidate; no bid or partner confirmed)
partners.notes: First-party NCTCOG case demonstrates Texas local-government ortho/LiDAR work and impervious polygons for five cities, not contract-specific QL1, 3 recent references, City approval, insurance, capacity or permissioned partner status.

partners.name: NV5 Geospatial (candidate; no bid or partner confirmed)
partners.notes: First-party provider contracts show USGS/USACE government lidar acquisition/processing but not this prime's RFP-specific experience and insurance, impervious billing, staff or subapproval.

workshare.summary: Only if an eligible in-house LiDAR prime and City permit a separately contracted independent Esri schema/data-dictionary and sample-acceptance QA slice; exclude all primary acquisition, remote sensing core processing and billing decisions.

milestones.deliverable: Prime-supplied authentic feature-class and City-approved schema gate
milestones.acceptance: Prime provides current City-approved original data dictionary and geodatabase access; independent reviewer documents 4 required Esri feature-class schemas with exact original field/type/length/nullability/domain proof

milestones.deliverable: Original exported 5+ sample and full-population preflight
milestones.acceptance: Prime receives reproducible original ArcPy export + Node22 preflight source reports, domain/percent/billing-ID coverage flags; separate specialist signs off spatial CRS and geometry
Prime acknowledges initial and retest results and City-owned QA exceptions without implying municipal acceptance or paid settlement
